principles: Never use a list position, section number, display title, URL pathname or date as a canonical record identity.
IDs do not change when a tile moves, an office changes hands, a story is amended, or the site is redesigned.
Use individual identities for original sources, source versions, claims, relationships, events, people, roles, institutions, funds, projects and derived stories.
Link a person to a role through dated, evidence-backed appointments, not through an immutable role occupant field.
Legacy records are archival leads until claim-by-claim checked against original materials; they are never imported as authoritative v2 facts.
Every canonical link resolves through one registry. Maintain redirects or historical links for verified old routes. Never redirect two different legacy subjects to one new subject by title alone.
Keep historical amendments and supersessions in a lineage graph. TTL expiry requires re-verification, never deletion.
All public publication and corrections retain human review and rollback.
Twin, Shadow and Learning IDs refer to reviewable model/candidate artifacts, never evidence of operational authority; models do not mint original source claims.

Stable geographic unit; include shapefile/official boundary edition
One issue identity across multiple subject families
One research project through multiple editions
Issuing document/work; versions and retrieval times separate
Atomic proposition with evidence states and temporal scope
Directed typed relation backed by claim IDs and effective dates
Historical or current event with start/end and status
Fund, grant, bond, appropriation or other financing instrument
Proposed, authorized, awarded, obligated, invoiced, paid and outcome as different events
Infrastructure or physical asset independent of project

Bounded system-model instance; identity is not an operational safety certification or an observed fact
Read-only comparator or observation candidate; no personal replica or execution authority in public systems
Append-only sourced learning/review candidate; separately human-approved amendment required
One Qified contextual article identity; each edition independently dated
Service or external learning resource; check eligibility, hours, current contact
Educational unit across topics, levels and age editions

uuidPolicy: UUID version 4 or 7 generated by a trusted creation service, never invented from a title. No new real-world entity UUID is issued from a candidate name match alone.

linkPolicy.unknownLink: 404 with parent subject navigation, never silent fallback to unrelated report
linkPolicy.legacyRoute: Keep archives readable; verified explicit 301/308 redirects only if content equivalence proven
linkPolicy.sourceUrls: Original HTTPS URL preserved unchanged, including publisher/document version; retrieval date and content digest stored separately
linkPolicy.citation: Citations point to exact source version, supporting excerpt/locator, verification date and claim IDs; render numbers per paper only as visual footnote order
